data.prompt: Chinese opera-pop fusion, 74BPM, D minor pentatonic. ALL vocals must be sung 戏腔/悲腔, NEVER spoken word, NEVER rap, NEVER 念白, NEVER whispering narration, NEVER a talking voice. If a line looks like dialogue, still sing it with melody. Opening 8 seconds: male 戏腔 vocalize 啊—— with jinghu answering, no talking. Verse also sung in restrained 戏腔, not pop speech-singing. Chorus is full 悲腔 with slides and held notes, tearful but pitched. Bridge is still sung 戏腔, higher, no recitation. Middle instrumental interlude MUST be a Chinese opera ensemble: jinghu lead, yueqin, small gong, clappers 板鼓, muted luo hits, short suona calls, not a modern pop guzheng loop. Second interlude: pipa plus jinghu, then one bar of complete silence, then chorus. Instruments enter and exit gradually. Real human opera-tinged male vocal, in tune, emotional, no spoken adlibs, no background talking, no radio voice. No EDM, no trap, no English, no dialogue.
